purpose: Quick technical acceptance after the user changed the v3 product target from Qwen to Luna. The model profile is part of the candidate product rather than a platform-only causal comparison.
userAuthorizedScope: Local isolated v3 only; no production or retired remote deployment changes.

acceptance.routing: A fresh browser and new session submit Luna without clicking the model picker; title and agent requests use Luna.
acceptance.C01: Native OpenCode fixes the reserved rename defect; CON.pdf is rejected, report.pdf remains valid, 95 tests and build pass.
acceptance.C05: Upload and rename persist through reload and PDF canvas preview opens; no source change unless a defect is reproduced; 95 tests and build pass.
acceptance.runtime: Candidate stops safely; accepted v2 is restored with no unresolved model dispatch.

decisionRule: All routing, C01, C05 and runtime checks must pass within 32 Luna dispatches per run. Passing yields READY_FOR_USER_ACCEPTANCE, not automatic human acceptance.
disclosure: The 32-dispatch Luna limit was frozen after observing the earlier 28-dispatch C05 exploration. These runs are new acceptance attempts and do not relabel the earlier frozen Qwen comparison.
